## This section is a work in progress.

Re-writing all of my lecture notes from the last 3 years with LaTex maths and coding all the plots is an ambitious endeavour, hence why this section is incomplete.
:::

This project started as I wanted to create a place for me to be able to access my university notes at any point in the future, no matter when I needed them. I also wanted them t be legible for years to come (and have to decipher any handwriting). This led me to creating this section on my website.
